title: Preparing the positive-dimensional polynomial lifting problem
statement: Let k be a field, A a finitely presented k-algebra, Λ a Noetherian k-algebra, α:A→Λ and q a prime whose localization is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] of positive dimension d. Put I=H_{A/k}Λ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] and assume I⊆q and q^nΛ_q⊆IΛ_q for n≥1. Then there exist c≥1, an evaluation φ:R=k[x_1,...,x_d]→Λ, a finitely presented R-algebra C carrying the compatible k-structure, and maps β:A→C and γ:C→Λ composing to α. The images π_i=φ(x_i) generate the maximal ideal of Λ_q; h_α⊆h_γ [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]; π_i^c∈q; on Λ/(π_j^(8c):j<i), annihilation by π_i equals annihilation by π_i²; and every image x_i^c in C is strictly standard over R [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. C can be taken in universe max(u,v), where k:Type u and A:Type v.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FE, as repaired in lem-weil-pbc-popescu-resolve-separable

proof.text: Choose finite generators a_j of H_{A/k}. Construct B=A[x_i,z_ij]/(x_i^n−Σ_j z_ij a_j); its presentation over R is finite.

Eliminate z_il after inverting a_l. This exhibits B_(a_l) as a polynomial extension of the smooth base change of A_(a_l). After inverting x_i the a_j generate the unit ideal; smoothness on their principal cover proves B_(x_i) smooth. The empty generator family produces the zero localization.

Improve B to C with a B-algebra retraction. Its indicated localizations are smooth, and at the x_i their differentials are free. Noetherianity makes C finitely presented. Choose a common positive strictly-standard exponent c.

Apply controlled generators with exponent e=8c and ideal I (not its radical). Obtain π_i with π_i^n∈I, the required localized generation, and the first/square annihilator equalities modulo the earlier e-th powers.

Write π_i^n=Σ λ_ij α(a_j). Evaluation x_i↦π_i,z_ij↦λ_ij annihilates the relations; compose with the retraction C→B. Smoothness of C_(a_j) places the image of each a_j in H_{C/R}, proving the required ideal containment after mapping and taking radicals. Contraction of the localized maximal ideal gives π_i∈q. Finite type over R over k gives a small presentation, transported to universe max(u,v).
